description: R4 showed the diagnostics downloader (kadry_diagnostiki.shag) and the CRM publication worker run independently, so UA-0020 was published before its diagnostics video was downloaded and never republished. GET-only export of the full sources of kadry_diagnostiki.py, ua_crm_public_sync.py, ua_publish_requests.py and run_all.py (credential lines redacted, URLs and long numbers masked) and the downloader log tail, to design the minimal fix through the existing publication queue. No writes.
title: Read-only diagnostics downloader and publication queue source probe
